description: Algorithm-equivalent scalar translations of the unchanged CoWasm Python corpus

benchmarks.equivalence: The same wheel-30 trial-division algorithm counts primes through 100000.
100000 calls to the same Euclidean loop and accumulated gcd result.
100000 calls to the same extended-Euclidean loop; accumulate the gcd coordinate.
Invert every integer from 1 through 99999 modulo 1073741827 using the translated xgcd.
Count iterations of range(0, 1000000, 3) with an explicit loop.
The same deliberately naive binary recursion with F(0)=F(1)=1 at n=30.
Six million integer-to-binary64 conversions and additions; checked against 35000000.0.
Five million binary64 absolute values and additions with the upstream tolerance.
Five million quotient/remainder pairs with Python floor-division semantics, including a negative dividend.
